name: manual_b4b39b
claim: When a Cursor cloud worker must coordinate with a Mac-local GossipBus, treat the SQLite board as intra-host only: cloud VMs cannot claim the local queue atomically. Use PR comments plus a local handoff file for remote visibility; on same-machine summons, emit via GossipBus and always pair agent_note with agent_pulse.

decisions.notes: Cloud SQLite boards are machine-local; remote claim races invent false ownership.

rationale: Cloud SQLite boards are machine-local; remote claim races invent false ownership.
